name: lupoflin
description: Netflix-like Jellyfin client for LG webOS TV, drawn with LightningJS (WebGL)

scripts.check:ui: mkdir -p .tmp && lng build > .tmp/build.log 2>&1 && node scripts/ui-check.mjs --brief profile:dev wait:home "until:s.data.rows && s.data.rows.length>1" key:Down key:Right sleep:1500 visible:20 shot:home
scripts.check: npm test && npm run check:api && npm run check:ui
